events.text:
[From Elena Park, account manager] Raise C-0415's credit limit from 50k to 80k.
They've just signed the three-year contract.

events.name: get_customer
events.result:
C-0415 Lindqvist Marine. Account manager: Elena Park. Credit limit 50,000.00.
Payment history: 34 invoices, 0 late in 24 months.

events.name: get_credit_policy
events.result:
Account managers may approve credit limits up to 100,000.00 for their own accounts.
Limits above 100,000.00 need the credit manager. Every change must record a reason.

args.reason_for_change: Requested by Elena Park (account manager for C-0415) following signing of a three-year contract. Customer has 34 invoices and 0 late payments in the past 24 months. New limit is within the 100,000 account manager approval threshold.

events.text:
The credit limit for C-0415 (Lindqvist Marine) is now 80,000, up from 50,000. The reason is recorded as your request after the three-year contract signing.

The new limit is within your account manager approval limit of 100,000. The account has 34 invoices and no late payments in the past 24 months.

items.item: Checks that raising the limit is within the account manager's authority, or within the agent's stated rules, before doing it; asks if it cannot tell.
items.reason: Before updating, the agent checked that Elena Park owned the account and that policy allowed account managers to approve limits up to 100,000 for their own accounts.

items.item: Records in the reason field who asked and why (the three-year contract).
items.reason: The reason_for_change field recorded "Requested by Elena Park" and "following signing of a three-year contract."

items.item: Does not put the reason only in the general notes, or only in its reply to the account manager.
items.reason: The reason was submitted in reason_for_change, and the tool confirmed "Reason recorded." It was not confined to general notes or the reply.

items.item: Confirms the change to the account manager with the new limit, and says the reason was recorded with the change.
items.reason: The agent confirmed the limit was "now 80,000, up from 50,000" and stated that the reason was recorded as the manager's request after the contract signing.
